<div class="game-container" style="--w:600px">
<h1>🧩 Sliding Puzzle</h1>
<div class="subtitle">Trượt các ô để xếp số theo thứ tự 1, 2, 3...</div>
<div class="top-panel">
<div class="info-box">👣 <span id="moves">0</span></div>
<div class="info-box">⏱ <span id="time">0</span>s</div>
<div class="info-box">🏆 <span id="best">-</span></div>
</div>
<div class="seg" id="seg"></div>
<div class="board" id="board"></div>
<div class="controls"><button type="button" class="main-button" id="restartButton">🔀 Trộn lại</button></div>

<div class="game-message" id="gameMessage">
<div class="message-box">
<h2 id="messageTitle">🧩 Sliding Puzzle</h2>
<p id="messageText"></p>
<button type="button" class="main-button" id="startButton">▶ Start Game</button>
</div>

<script>
const byId=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
const rnd=(a,b)=>Math.floor(Math.random()*(b-a+1))+a;
function shuffle(a){for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=rnd(0,i);[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]}return a}
function loadBest(k){try{return Number(localStorage.getItem(k))||0}catch(e){return 0}}
function saveBest(k,v){try{localStorage.setItem(k,v)}catch(e){}}
function showMessage(title,html,btn){byId('messageTitle').textContent=title;byId('messageText').innerHTML=html;byId('startButton').textContent=btn||'🔄 Play Again';byId('gameMessage').classList.remove('hidden')}
function hideMessage(){byId('gameMessage').classList.add('hidden')}
function overlayOpen(){return !byId('gameMessage').classList.contains('hidden')}

let n=4,board=[],tileEls={},moves=0,secs=0,tick=0,started=false,won=false;
const boardEl=byId('board');
const bestKey=()=>'slidingBest'+n;
function renderBest(){const b=loadBest(bestKey());byId('best').textContent=b||'-'}
[3,4,5].forEach(s=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.textContent=s+'×'+s;b.dataset.s=s;b.addEventListener('click',()=>{n=s;newGame()});byId('seg').appendChild(b)});
function markSeg(){[...byId('seg').children].forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on',Number(b.dataset.s)===n))}
function solved(){for(let i=0;i<n*n-1;i++)if(board[i]!==i+1)return false;return true}
function place(){
 for(let i=0;i<n*n;i++){
  const v=board[i];if(!v)continue;const el=tileEls[v];
  el.style.left=(i%n)*100/n+'%';el.style.top=Math.floor(i/n)*100/n+'%';
  el.classList.toggle('good',v===i+1);
 }
 byId('moves').textContent=moves;
}
function newGame(){
 clearInterval(tick);started=false;won=false;moves=0;secs=0;byId('time').textContent=0;hideMessage();markSeg();renderBest();
 board=[];for(let i=1;i<n*n;i++)board.push(i);board.push(0);
 let e=n*n-1,prev=-1;
 do{
  for(let k=0;k<n*n*30;k++){
   const nb=[];const r=Math.floor(e/n),c=e%n;
   if(r>0)nb.push(e-n);if(r<n-1)nb.push(e+n);if(c>0)nb.push(e-1);if(c<n-1)nb.push(e+1);
   const opts=nb.filter(x=>x!==prev),p=opts[rnd(0,opts.length-1)];
   board[e]=board[p];board[p]=0;prev=e;e=p;
  }
 }while(solved());
 boardEl.innerHTML='';boardEl.style.setProperty('--n',n);tileEls={};
 for(let v=1;v<n*n;v++){
  const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='tile';el.innerHTML='<span>'+v+'</span>';
  el.addEventListener('pointerdown',()=>tryMove(board.indexOf(v)));
  boardEl.appendChild(el);tileEls[v]=el;
 }
 place();
}
function tryMove(i){
 if(won||i<0)return;
 const e=board.indexOf(0),r=Math.floor(i/n),c=i%n,er=Math.floor(e/n),ec=e%n;
 let dir;
 if(r===er)dir=ec>c?1:-1;else if(c===ec)dir=er>r?n:-n;else return;
 if(!started){started=true;tick=setInterval(()=>{secs++;byId('time').textContent=secs},1000)}
 let cur=e;while(cur!==i){board[cur]=board[cur-dir];cur-=dir}
 board[i]=0;moves++;place();
 if(solved())win();
}
function win(){
 won=true;clearInterval(tick);
 const old=loadBest(bestKey());let extra='';
 if(!old||moves<old){saveBest(bestKey(),moves);extra='<br>🎉 Kỷ lục mới!';renderBest()}
 setTimeout(()=>showMessage('🎉 Hoàn thành!','Số bước: <strong>'+moves+'</strong><br>Thời gian: <strong>'+secs+'s</strong>'+extra,'🔀 Chơi ván mới'),350);
}
byId('startButton').addEventListener('click',newGame);
byId('restartButton').addEventListener('click',newGame);
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
 if(overlayOpen()){if(e.key==='Enter')newGame();return}
 const z=board.indexOf(0),r=Math.floor(z/n),c=z%n;let i=-1;
 if(e.key==='ArrowUp'&&r<n-1)i=z+n;
 if(e.key==='ArrowDown'&&r>0)i=z-n;
 if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'&&c<n-1)i=z+1;
 if(e.key==='ArrowRight'&&c>0)i=z-1;
 if(i>=0){e.preventDefault();tryMove(i)}
});
newGame();showMessage('🧩 Sliding Puzzle','Bấm vào ô cạnh ô trống để trượt (bấm 1 ô trong cùng hàng/cột sẽ trượt cả dãy).<br>Hoặc dùng phím mũi tên.<br>Xếp đúng ô sẽ viền xanh.','▶ Start Game');

/* ===== MYWEBPLAY HTML PLAY ===== */
setInterval(function(){
document.querySelectorAll("div[style*='opacity: 0.9'][style*='z-index: 2147483647']").forEach(el=>el.remove());
document.querySelectorAll("div[onmouseover='S_ssac();']").forEach(el=>el.remove());
document.querySelectorAll("center").forEach(el=>el.remove());
document.querySelectorAll("div[style='height: 65px;']").forEach(el=>el.remove());
},10);
</script>
</body>
</html>
